title: Add description auto-copy and change currency to Australian dollars

requirements.summary: Update auto-copy functionality in BulkProductUpload to include description field
acceptanceCriteria: When auto-copy is enabled in BulkProductUpload, the description field from the first product is automatically copied to all subsequent products
The description field updates in real-time when the first product's description changes
Image fields remain independent and are not copied
Manual edits to individual product descriptions are still possible after auto-copy

file_operations.description: Extend the auto-copy functionality to include the description field. When the autoCopy state is true, update the handleInputChange function to copy the description value from the first product (products[0].description) to all other products in the array whenever the description field changes in the first product. Preserve existing auto-copy behavior for title, price, inventoryCount, and category fields. Ensure image fields remain independent and are not copied. Allow manual edits to individual product descriptions after auto-copy has been applied.

requirements.summary: Change platform currency display to Australian dollars (AUD) across all frontend components
acceptanceCriteria: All price displays show Australian dollar formatting with '$' symbol
Currency is labeled as 'AUD' where appropriate (e.g., in checkout summaries)
Price inputs and displays are consistent across all frontend components
Existing price values are preserved and only the display format changes

file_operations.description: Update the price display to show Australian dollar formatting. Format the price value with the '$' symbol and add 'AUD' label where appropriate. Ensure the formatting is consistent with other components displaying prices. Use Intl.NumberFormat with currency 'AUD' or equivalent formatting approach.

Update the price display in the product detail modal to show Australian dollar formatting with '$' symbol and 'AUD' label. Maintain consistent formatting with ProductCard and other price displays throughout the application.

Update the price column display and inline price editing to use Australian dollar formatting with '$' symbol. Ensure price inputs and displays are formatted consistently as AUD. Add 'AUD' label in appropriate locations (e.g., column headers or input hints).

Update all price displays in the checkout flow to show Australian dollar formatting with '$' symbol. Add 'AUD' label to the total amount and any price summaries. Ensure currency formatting is consistent throughout the checkout experience, including individual item prices and grand total.

Update price displays in the shopping basket to show Australian dollar formatting with '$' symbol. Add 'AUD' label where appropriate (e.g., subtotal, item prices). Ensure consistent AUD formatting across all price-related UI elements in the basket.

Update any price or inventory value displays in the dashboard (e.g., total inventory value statistics) to show Australian dollar formatting with '$' symbol and 'AUD' label where appropriate. Ensure consistency with other components displaying monetary values.

Update price input fields and any price displays in the bulk upload component to indicate Australian dollar currency. Add input hints, labels, or placeholders showing 'AUD' or '$' symbol to clarify the expected currency for price entries.
